diagnostic_evidence.quote: Let ${\bf y}$ be the signal of length $dN$ formed by stacking $d$ copies of $\tilde{{\bf x}}$ in frequency space

issues.failure_explanation: With the paper's DFT convention, if $\tilde y$ is formed by repeating $\tilde x$ exactly $d$ times, then the inverse DFT gives $y_{dn}=x_n$, not $d x_n$. For example, when $N=1$ and $d=2$, $\tilde x=[a]$ and $\tilde y=[a,a]$, whose inverse DFT is $y=[a,0]$, so $y_0=a$, not $2a$. The omitted proof would establish the zero entries correctly but cannot establish the stated factor $d$.

failure_location.quote:
Additionally, for all $0\le n < N$,
    $y_{dn} = dx_n$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the conclusion $y_{dn}=dx_n$ by $y_{dn}=x_n$, or equivalently multiply the repeated copies of $\tilde x$ by $d$ before forming $\tilde y$.
issues.overall_effect: The lemma as stated is false in its second conclusion. The paper only uses the fact that $y_n=0$ when $d\nmid n$, so the main downstream arguments are not invalidated, but the formal lemma itself is unreliable.
issues.title: Frequency-stacking lemma has an incorrect factor d
issues.why_classification: The error is local and does not affect the only part of the lemma used later; a one-line correction preserves all substantive claims.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: We first show the existence of an $m$ and $n$ that satisfy \Cref{eq:to_satisfy} for each $0 \le j < D$.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof shows that for every $j$ there is some $(m,n)$ with $mkN_2'+nlN_1'=jd\pmod N$. This only proves that the image of the map contains the $D$ multiples of $d$; it does not prove that the image contains no additional cosets. To conclude that there are exactly $D$ cosets, one must also show that the image is contained in the multiples of $d$ (equivalently, that $d$ divides both coefficients $kN_2'$ and $lN_1'$). The source does not supply that missing argument.

failure_location.quote: Since the set of cosets partitions the group evenly and there are $D$ cosets of $H$ (as there are $D$ choices of $j$), we have shown that each entry of the subsignal is a sum of $|H| = N_1N_2/D$ entries of ${\tt X}$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the missing step that $d$ divides both $kN_2'$ and $lN_1'$, so the image is exactly the subgroup of multiples of $d$, which has size $D$.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the counting lemma is incomplete as written. The lemma statement is true, but its later use in Lemma amb2D relies on an unproved counting assertion.
issues.title: Subsignal-count lemma has an incomplete coset-count argument
issues.why_classification: The statement is true and the missing argument is short and local; repairing it does not change any later result or require new proof architecture.

diagnostic_evidence.quote:
If $p \ndivs N_1$, then $\gcd(pk, N_1) = \gcd(k, N_1)$.
Additionally, $p$ must divide $N_2$, so $\gcd(pl, N_2) = p\gcd(l, N_2) = N_2/(D_2/p)$.
Note that since $D \divs \lcm(N_1, N_2)$, its prime factor $p$ must divide $N_1$ or $N_2$, so this argument shows that each required decimated subsignal is available.

issues.failure_explanation: The identity $\gcd(pk,N_1)=p\gcd(k,N_1)$ is false when $p$ already divides $\gcd(k,N_1)$. For instance, with $N_1=12$, $k=6$, and $p=3$, one has $\gcd(18,12)=6$, whereas $3\gcd(6,12)=18$. In that situation $D_1$ does not decrease even though $p\mid N_1$. The correct case split is whether $p\mid D_1$ or $p\mid D_2$: if $p\mid D_1$, then $D_1/p<D_1$; if $p\nmid D_1$, then $p\mid D_2$ and $D_2/p<D_2$. The algorithm's iteration order remains correct, but the supplied verification is invalid as written.

failure_location.quote: If $p \divs N_1$, then $\gcd(pk, N_1) = p\gcd(k, N_1) = N_1/(D_1/p)$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the case split by the correct one: if $p\mid D_1$, then $D_1$ decreases; otherwise $p\mid D_2$ and $D_2$ decreases.
issues.overall_effect: The proof that alg:memo_2D has all required decimated subsignals available before each ILP is flawed. The algorithm itself is not shown to fail, but its correctness verification in the source is incomplete.
issues.title: Incorrect case split in the verification of memoized 2D iteration order
issues.why_classification: The algorithmic guarantee is true and the repair is a short local correction to the proof; no change to the algorithm or its output is needed.
